versions.changelog:
Initial release of the release-writing skill.

- Defines organizational standards for changelog and release note formatting.
- Outlines a step-by-step release workflow, including verification, changelog preparation, PR procedure, tagging, and post-release checks.
- Specifies what content should or should not be included in public release materials.
- Includes guidance on updating previous releases and cleaning up after repository renames.
- Provides migration instructions for applying these standards to an existing repository.
